Name: Qi Exchanger
Author: Mizzion
TagLine: This mod allows you to exchange QiCoins (Casino Currency) back into gold.
Description:
Have you bought everything you needed from the Casino, but still have Qi Coins (Casino Currency) left over? If so this mod will allow you to exchange them back into gold coins.

Usage Instructions:
While in game, hit the F9 button. This is configurable inside the config.json file created once you run the game for the first time.

This mod is Translation Compatible. If you would like me to translate it into your language, open the i18n/default.json and translate the text. Then message me. I will get it updated.

Install Instructions:

*   Install the latest SMAPI (Currently 2.5.2) from [SMAPI Download](https://smapi.io)

*   Unzip the QiExchanger folder

*   Place the folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder

*   Run the game.

*   Hit F9
